content.subject: Quick thought on your tech approach
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

You noted Episode Six treats tech decisions like payments: flexible, scalable.

I appreciate your insight.

That could perhaps imply your finance team still reconciles many transactions manually, though I could be mistaken.

We run a rule‑based engine that matches incoming payment data to ledger entries without manual input.

Do you have 15 minutes next week to see if it fits?

Zamp
